displayName: Atlas Storage v4 — sync unexpected errors — dev

documentation.content: Disabled Phase K template. Fires when sync flush telemetry reports unexpected errors in a 5-minute alignment window. Enable only after the metric is created, baseline is reviewed, and a notification channel/owner is approved.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND metric.type="logging.googleapis.com/user/atlas_storage_v4_sync_events" AND metric.labels.event="flush" AND metric.labels.outcome="unexpected-error"
